name: swarm-manager
description: swarm-manager declared measures surface plus the agent-operations operator surface. This manifest is the SSOT for the scenario's analytical measures (the granular replacement for the monolithic /stats blob) — consumed by measures-health (coverage + behavioral probe) and the search-hub central index — and models the AgentOperationsService command bindings and governance. swarm-manager's broader CLI is hand-registered (not yet manifest-driven).

groups.name: agent-operations
groups.description: Declarative agent-operations operator surface: catalog/compatibility/binding/workflow/provenance projections, mutating binding-override administration, and the idempotent reconciliation sweep. All commands are thin Connect clients over AgentOperationsService. The overrides trio is invoked as 'agent-operations overrides {list|set|clear}' (one registered subcommand dispatching on its first positional); the dashed names here are the manifest identifiers for the three bound RPCs.

commands.name: resolve-binding
commands.description: Resolve the winning binding for an operation against a target by deterministic precedence.

flags.name: target
flags.description: Target id (backlog item kind/name, initiative name, plan execution id, or scenario name).

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Dry-run-validate an invocation (declared, target-compatible, binding-resolvable) without starting a run.

commands.name: inspect-workflow
commands.description: Inspect the durable workflow instance correlating a target's operation executions.

commands.name: inspect-execution
commands.description: Inspect an execution's pinned provenance, outcome, and snapshot reproducibility.

commands.name: catalog
commands.description: List every authored operation contract with its pinned revision and compatible target kinds.

commands.name: compatible-modes
commands.description: List authored operating modes with server-computed per-operation compatibility verdicts for a target.

flags.name: operation
flags.description: Narrow verdicts to one catalog operation id (optional).

commands.name: bindings
commands.description: Resolve the winning binding per catalog operation for a target, with source layer and contributing layers.

flags.name: verbose
flags.description: Show every contributing layer, not just the winner.

commands.name: overrides-list
commands.description: List the raw binding-override documents stored at one owner's layer, with file-level provenance. Invoked as 'agent-operations overrides list'.

flags.name: owner
flags.description: Owner id (backlog item kind/name, or initiative name).

commands.name: overrides-set
commands.description: Write (idempotent-replace) one binding override at the owner's layer; validated fail-closed before the write. Snapshot-at-invoke: affects only operations started afterwards. Invoked as 'agent-operations overrides set'.

flags.name: version
flags.description: Exact operation version pin (optional; empty binds across versions).

flags.name: mode-revision
flags.description: Exact mode content revision to pin.

flags.name: disabled
flags.description: Write a fail-closed veto: refuse the operation for this scope.

commands.name: overrides-clear
commands.description: Delete the owner's binding override for an operation (+ optional exact version pin); reports found=false for an absent override rather than erroring. Invoked as 'agent-operations overrides clear'.

flags.name: version
flags.description: Exact version pin of the stored override (optional).

commands.name: workflow
commands.description: Canonical workflow projection: durable state, operations enriched with mode@revision/binding layer/attempt lineage, decisions, timers, and legal actions.

commands.name: history
commands.description: Execution provenance summaries for a target, newest first.

flags.name: limit
flags.description: Cap the number of summaries returned (0 = no cap).

commands.name: migration-status
commands.description: Read the persisted-state migration status document (written by the Phase-8 migration tooling); absent means not-started.

commands.name: reconcile
commands.description: Run the idempotent, race-safe orphan-snapshot reconciliation sweep (the same sweep the API runs at startup); mutates only by reaping aged, unreferenced execution snapshots.

commands.name: completed
commands.description: Count backlog items completed in a time window.

flags.name: window
flags.description: Time window token (this_week, last_7d, last_30d, this_month, last_month, this_quarter).

measure.intent: How many backlog items were completed in a time window.
questions: how many backlog items did we complete this week
how many work items were finished in the last 7 days

commands.name: created
commands.description: Count backlog items created in a time window.

flags.name: window
flags.description: Time window token (this_week, last_7d, last_30d, this_month, last_month, this_quarter).

measure.intent: How many backlog items were created in a time window.
questions: how many backlog items were created this week
new work items added last month
how many backlog items did we add in the last 30 days

commands.name: dismiss
commands.description: Dismiss a suggested auto-filer item and remember its finding.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show backlog auto-filer policy and latest cycle status.

commands.name: run-now
commands.description: Run one governed auto-filer cycle immediately.

commands.name: completed
commands.description: Count executions completed in a time window.

flags.name: window
flags.description: Time window token (this_week, last_7d, last_30d, this_month, last_month, this_quarter).

measure.intent: How many executions completed in a time window.
questions: how many executions completed this week
how many runs completed in the last 7 days

commands.name: created
commands.description: Count initiatives created in a time window.

flags.name: window
flags.description: Time window token (this_week, last_7d, last_30d, this_month, last_month, this_quarter).

measure.intent: How many initiatives were created in a time window.
questions: how many initiatives were created this week
how many initiatives did we open this quarter

commands.name: created
commands.description: Count agent sessions created in a time window.

flags.name: window
flags.description: Time window token (this_week, last_7d, last_30d, this_month, last_month, this_quarter).

measure.intent: How many agent sessions were created in a time window.
questions: how many agent sessions were created this week
how many agent sessions did we open in the last 7 days

Captures are an ephemeral pre-triage inbox: they are converted into backlog items and initiatives (counted there) and emit no creation event of their own, so they carry no durable historical value to measure independently.

domains.reason: agent_activity is a live, derived view of in-flight agent-manager runs (a polling projection), not a persisted swarm-manager entity; it has no event-log presence and no countable historical rows.
graph holds structural/presentation node positions for the workspace canvas, not historical countable rows.
operations is a computed operations-briefing summary derived on read from other domains, not a persisted entity with its own rows.
plan is the Plan-lens board projection (dependency waves + gates read-model) computed on read from backlog/execution/capture state; it owns no persisted rows of its own.
scenario is a read-through catalog of the scenarios/ directory (configuration metadata), not swarm-manager-owned persisted state.
